issues: 三个速剪镜头是灰色通用 dashboard 占位图，9f 里看不出任何内容，钩子不抓人
三镜构图差别不大（两张全景 + 一张放大），速剪读不出景别变化
开场标题是浅灰底上的「THE LAUNCH」，字小、平、没有光，黑场之后亮起来像幻灯片
标题落定后 77f 完全静止，尾段死帧
changes: custom look（青黑 + 琥珀的预告片调色）；三个速剪镜头为同一虚构产品「Cinder」量身设计：微距命令行（荷兰角 −7°、上下行景深虚化）/ 420px 琥珀渐变「0.4s」+ 透视网格地平线 / Deploy 按钮被光标按下（反向荷兰角 +6°、按下压缩 + 光环）
保留骨架：三镜各 9f 等长硬切 + 每镜 1→1.04 匀速微推、27–33f 纯黑静默
开场：舞台 14f 由黑亮起，230px「CINDER」逐字由虚到实从中间向两边绽开、字距 0.42em→0.16em 缓收，一道琥珀宽银幕光条横扫标题中线一次
眉题 A NEW WAY TO SHIP / 42px 副题 / 日期 10 · 14 依次跟进，层级分明
hold 70f 不再死帧：3% 极缓推近 + 光带呼吸 + 琥珀余烬浮尘上飘（呼应品牌名）
issuesEn: The three quick cuts were grey generic dashboard placeholders; nothing was readable in 9f, so the hook didn't grab
The three compositions were barely different (two wides and one zoom), so the cuts didn't read as changes of shot size
The title was 'THE LAUNCH' on a pale grey card: small, flat and unlit, so coming out of black felt like a slideshow
After the title settled the frame stayed completely still for 77f, a dead tail
changesEn: Custom teal-and-amber trailer grade; the three cuts are designed for one fictional product, 'Cinder': a macro command line (−7° Dutch angle, depth-of-field blur on the lines above and below), a 420px amber-gradient '0.4s' over a perspective grid horizon, and a Deploy button pressed by the cursor (+6° Dutch angle, press squash and ring)
The skeleton is kept: three equal 9f hard cuts, each with a constant 1→1.04 push, then 27–33f of pure black silence

The open: the stage rises out of black over 14f, a 230px 'CINDER' blooms letter by letter from blur outward from the centre while tracking eases from 0.42em to 0.16em, and one amber anamorphic streak sweeps the title's centre line
Kicker 'A NEW WAY TO SHIP', a 42px subtitle and the date '10 · 14' follow in turn with clear hierarchy
The 70f hold is no longer dead: a 3% slow push, a breathing light band and drifting amber embers that echo the brand name
